fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Chinese language proficiency certificate * 2. No criminal record certificate * 3. Scanned copy of the original Physical Examination Form for Foreigners The form must be the version uniformly issued by Chinese health and quarantine authorities and completed in Chinese or English. You can download a template or sample from here . * 4. ID photo (2-inch bareheaded, front portrait against a blue background). * 5. Complete academic transcripts for the highest level of education attained (Chinese/English transcripts are acceptable; if in a language other than English, a notarized English translation is required) * 6. Scanned copy of the information page of a valid passport * 7. Scanned copy of the Fujian Medical University Financial Guarantee Form for International Students And supporting financial documents, demonstrating personal funds, family support, government sponsorship, or financial sponsor backing. You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. Highest academic qualification certificate If the applicant is currently enrolled as a student, a pre-graduation certificate or certificate of enrollment issued by the institution must be submitted. Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 9. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -Mathematics is a compulsory subject, and one elective must be chosen between Physics and Chemistry; taking the CSCA examination exempts candidates from the school's own entrance examination. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Non Chinese citizens aged 18-30, graduated from high school or equivalent educational one, physically and mentally healthy (without color blindness or color weakness). 2. Those whose parents (one or both) are Chinese citizens and have settled in a foreign country, who have foreign nationality at the time of their birth, and who immigrate from the Chinese Mainland, Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan to foreign countries, as applicants for studying in China, must hold valid foreign passports or international certification documents for at least 4 years, and there is a record of actual residence abroad for at least 2 years in the past 4 years (as of April 30th of the enrollment year). 3. Language Proficiency Requirements: Applicants must have proof of HSK Level 4 (no less than 180 points) or other equivalent Chinese proficiency tests. Those whose medium of instruction during the whole learning period of the highest academic qualification is Chinese can be exempted from the certification of Chinese test results, but must submit the certification of Chinese teaching issued by the graduation college or university. 4. The previous academic performance shall meet one of the following requirements: (1) Excellent performance in senior high school graduation examinations, with the score of mathematics no less than 70 points (out of 100 points), and the score of either physics or chemistry also no less than 70 points (out of 100 points). (2) Having completed the Preparatory program recognized by our university and met the graduation standards. 5. A score not lower than 70 points (on a 100-point scale) in the entrance interview (conducted remotely or on campus). 6. CSCA score report: Mathematics is a compulsory subject; either Physics or Chemistry may be chosen as an additional subject.
